rows.q: Who lives in San Diego in MDS?
rows.answer:
Happy to break down what I can pull from! Here's the toolkit:

• *WhatsApp chats & digests* - across all the MDS groups you're in, so I can search past discussions or summarize what happened on a given day
• *Facebook group* - posts and comments, so I can find threads on a topic or pull up what people are saying
• *Member profiles* - public info like niche, expertise, city/state, revenue tier, hobbies (never exact revenue or private details)
• *Events* - upcoming registrations, past event history, who's attending
• *Partner deals* - the vetted partner directory for things like freight, software, accounting, etc.
• *Video library* - Mogul Calls, Expert Calls, webinars by topic or speaker (though I can't search inside the actual recording content yet - that's coming)

Just ask things like "what were people saying about tariffs last month" or "any partner deals for 3PLs."
